editorial: Imagine waking up in first class and realizing your reality could be a step closer to Hollywood. Upgraded weaves the cutthroat art world into a cocktail of glitter and sharp wit. Grace Kimmerling’s understated humor and the film’s absurd, almost photorealistic set pieces keep you glued. You’re in for a breezy, ambitious fantasy if you love feel‑good office comedies, though the second act meanders a touch.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of feel‑good office comedies with a glossy, sarcastic edge.
